title: Impact of retrieval augmented generation and large language model complexity on undergraduate exams created and taken by AI agents

live_model.evidence: Sec. 3: "Each assistant was created with the model set as either GPT-3.5 Turbo or GPT-4 Turbo"; artifact counts are "as of March 2024", i.e. before the 2024-04-09 GA snapshot.

prompt.location: Supplementary Appendices A-C (exam generation and answering instructions), not in the main text

claim.metric: model rank on exam metrics (ROUGE, embedding similarity)

data.source: a single copyrighted undergraduate textbook used as the RAG corpus via the OpenAI Assistants API file search

notes: Experiments ran around March 2024 through the Assistants API, so GPT-4 Turbo means a preview snapshot; the textbook corpus is not distributable and the Assistants retrieval pipeline is not reproducible from prompts.
